heading_en: Amount of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets for Purchased Receivables
summary_ja: 購入債権の信用リスク・アセットの額は、デフォルト・リスク相当部分と希薄化リスク相当部分の合計額とする（希薄化リスクが重要でない場合は前者のみ）。
summary_en: The credit risk-weighted assets of purchased receivables are the sum of the default risk portion and the dilution risk portion (the default risk portion alone if dilution risk is not material).
paragraphs: Notwithstanding Articles 129 through 142, the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of purchased receivables shall be the sum of the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the default risk portion and the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the dilution risk portion; provided, however, that where the dilution risk portion is not material, it may be the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the default risk portion.
